exposure: prophylactic balloon occlusion of the internal iliac artery (PBOIIA)
Prophylactic balloon occlusion of the internal iliac artery (PBOIIA)
cohort: 420 women with placenta previa and accreta who underwent cesarean section (CS)
finding: While PBOIIA did not significantly reduce EBL or hysterectomy rates in patients with placenta previa and accreta, it did decrease the amount of PRBCs transfused in those with massive hemorrhage, but at a significantly higher financial cost.
